dsh-mascot 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

posts.en:
dsh-mascot is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bbfd2a9b9f48322c4584.html
